name: Article Writer
description: Advanced Article Writer with Humanizer to bypass AI detectors and mimic specific journalism styles.

howToUse:
1. Enter your main topic or keywords.
2. Select the media style (e.g., Forbes, BuzzFeed, Vice).
3. Set the desired length and perspective.
4. Adjust the 'Humanizer' to make the text feel more natural or raw.
5. Click 'Write' to generate.
features:
• Anti-AI Cloaking
• Media Style Mimicry
• Markdown Support
